Frankfort Town Court

Address: 201 Third Ave, Frankfort, NY 13340, United States

Phone: 315-895-7267

Frankfort Town Court is located in the Town Hall of Frankfort, United States. It is one of the 26 other town and village courts in Herkimer County, New York, located in the 5th and 4th Judicial Departments. It hears and solves cases of criminal, traffic, and vehicle violation, civil, and small claims matters. It also had a separate Court known as Frankfort Village Court.

How to do Case Search?

Frankfort Town Court case search can be done online using first and last name, city, or state. After filling in all the information, you got all the case information; some records are confidential and unavailable online. You had to get these types of documents from the clerk's office.

How to request open records?

Frankfort Town Court open record requests for documents can be made in the following ways:

  • Fill out the open record request form.
  • Please send the form to the court mailing address or appear in person at the court and submit it at the front desk of the city hall clerk's office.
  • Within five business days, you will get a response on the status of your request.

see also courthouse" Waukesha County Courthouse

How to make payment:

Frankfort Town Court payment can be made in the following ways:

In-Person

A person can make payment by visiting the court during business hours and paying in cash, checks, or with a card at the counter. A credit card holder must appear in court with a photo ID, and service fees are deducted using this service.

Online

A person can pay online by using www.paycourtonline.com. They accept all online payment methods.

Mail

A Person can send a certified check to the court's mailing address. The address is 201 Third Ave, Frankfort, NY 13340, United States. Cash is not accepted in mail forms.

What type of cases are handled by the Traffic Division?

Frankfort Town Court Traffic court hears and solves cases related to traffic-related matters like speeding, accidents, violation, broken vehicle, and many more. If you receive a speeding ticket, you must send a plea of guilty or not guilty before the date written on the key. You should hire a specialized traffic attorney for this case.

What types of cases are handled by the Criminal Division?

Frankfort Town Court Criminal Court hears and solves cases related to criminal matters like murder, kidnapping, and many more. In criminal cases, you must appear on the court date with your attorney, and you cannot enter a guilty plea for these types of cases. All charges are prosecuted by the district attorney in the criminal court.

What are the responsibilities of the Clerk's office in town?

Frankfort Town Court clerk's office responsibilities are:

  • Issue Marriage licenses and copies
  • Issue Birth and Death certificates copies
  • Issue permits and other types of grants.
  • Search Genealogy records

How to get a marriage license?

Frankfort Town Court marriage license can be obtained from the town clerk. The permit cost, including the registration fees, is $40. The couple's age must be 18+. If the age is 16 or 17, parents or guardians must be present at the time of submission. If the age is less than 16, then first Supreme Court permission is required for the marriage, and then with parents' form will be submitted. A licensed couple should fill out the registration form and come to court with a photo-Id card like a passport, driving license, etc. for photo identification and pay the fees at the court. Validity is up to 6 months, and a marriage ceremony is held at the court after getting the right. If a person has been married before, a divorce copy must be submitted to the court before getting the certificate.

How to get copies of birth and death certificates?

Frankfort Town Court birth and death certificate copies can be obtained from the town's clerk. The fee is $10 for each document. To obtain copies, you had to fill out all the information on the form and submit the state to the clerk's office. A photo Identification card will be presented along with the paper.

When is an Appearance in court necessary?

Frankfort Town Court appearance is necessary in criminal or some traffic cases. In traffic cases, you send a plea of guilty or not guilty, and then the court will respond whether you need to appear in court for the patient or you have to pay fines only. In some cases paying fees on time is required, and appearance is not needed.

see also El Paso County District Court

How much are the speeding fines?

Frankfort Town Court speeding fines depend upon your driving speed. When you do a speeding violation, you get a fine and some points, and the increase in points will result in the suspension of your driving license. Speeding limits up to 10 mph will result in a fine of $45 to $150, 3 points will be added to your driving records, and total surcharges will become $88 or $93.

FAQ

When will traffic and criminal case hearings be scheduled?

Frankfort Town Court traffic cases hearing schedules are:

  • Tuesday at 5:00 pm
  • Thursday at 10:00 am

What type of cases are handled by the Civil Division?

Frankfort Town Court Civil Court deals with all the cases that citizens will not be able to solve on their own.

What proof of identity is required for getting a marriage certificate?

Any photo identification that proves identity is mandatory for getting the certificate. These includes:

  • Passport
  • Photo Driving License
  • Non-driver’s license issued by DMV
  • Military Photo-ID
  • Employee’s card

Who can perform a marriage ceremony?

Frankfort Town Court marriage ceremonies can be performed by any judge, mayor, or marriage officer.

What will happen if I do not pay fines on time?

If you do not pay fines on time, an extra penalty will be added, your driver's license will be suspended, or a warrant against you will be issued.

What are the fees for the copy of genealogy records?

$10 is the fee for each document for getting the genealogy records.

What is the phone number of the clerk of the town?

Frankfort Town Court clerk of the town phone number is 315-894-8737.
